data.narrative: both agents were given the same 218-character prompt and no expected answer; no instructions recorded on either side; different models: activities-small activities-small, activities-strong activities-strong; activities-small read 0 sources and activities-strong 1, 0 shared (Jaccard 0); activities-small's answer carries no typed value; activities-strong's answer carries no typed value.
